structural_law: Because S≈P while C≈P/log^O P, the full-S inverse window contains only polylog many complete residue blocks modulo each c. Thus the incomplete s-window itself is no longer the sharp obstruction: it can be completed algebraically. The obstruction moves to the completed residue weights B_{c,x}, which depend on c and are not flat for generic divisor-bounded beta_s. Therefore the remaining theorem input is a modulus-dependent completed Kloosterman average, not a vague full-S estimate.
